findings.fix: Remove. Use words or real imagery.
A page needs about five: display, heading, lead, body, small.

findings.message: No video anywhere on the page.
findings.fix: Look for one honest clip with scripts/assets.mjs --video (the place, the material, the process) and use it as a muted loop with a poster frame. Defend its absence only if no clip fits the subject.

findings.message: Longest paragraph runs about 101 characters per line.

findings.fix: Nothing meant to be read goes below 13px.

findings.message: 29% of the first screen is one empty block (780×480px at 660,120).
findings.fix: Place the void on purpose or fill it: move the picture, the film or one fact into it, grow the headline to meet it, or shrink the screen to its content. A void reads as placed only when something closes it on the far side and it is the screen's one rest.

findings.message: 8 text block(s) sit within 16px of the screen edge: "An operator’s marketing practi" (0px from the left); "Founded 2022 · Columbus, Ohio" (0px from the left); "Reply within one business day" (0px from the right); "Hightower Marketing Strategies" (0px from the left)
findings.fix: Keep text inside the page margin (16–32px or more). Only display type deliberately bled past the edge may touch it.

findings.message: The running text is a soft grey on its ground (4.6:1).
findings.fix: Set body copy in the full ink (7:1 or more). Keep the muted ink for secondary notes; pages read thin and unfinished when everything is grey.

findings.message: The h1 is a bare name ("Hightower Marketing") and nothing else on the first screen says what this is.
findings.fix: Keep the name if it leads, and give the line under it (18px or more) the plain words: what it is, for whom, where or when. In the study of 97 Sites of the Day, first screens that named nothing lost usability and content points.

findings.message: A section carries text but no heading: section#contact at 11492px.
findings.fix: Name it with a short heading unless it is the continuation of the section above.
